kitchens.name: Nigerian Kitchen
kitchens.description: Party jollof, rich soups and open-flame grills from across Nigeria: cooked the way our mothers taught us, plated the way Lagos deserves.

kitchens.name: Polish Kitchen
kitchens.tagline: Rye, dill and slow Sunday cooking
kitchens.description: Hand-pinched pierogi, sour rye soups and slow-braised stews from Kraków to the Tatra mountains: Polish comfort food with fine-dining care.

kitchens.name: Continental Kitchen
kitchens.description: Wellingtons, aged steaks and French classics, cooked with precision and finished with a West African wink.

dishes.name: Smoky Party Jollof
dishes.short_description: Firewood-smoked jollof, grilled chicken, sweet plantain.
dishes.description: The rice every Lagos party is judged by. Long-grain rice simmered in a slow-cooked tomato and tatashe base, finished over firewood for that unmistakable smoky "bottom-pot" note. Served with flame-grilled chicken, caramelised dodo and a sharp pepper relish.
dishes.ingredients: Long-grain parboiled rice, plum tomato, tatashe, scotch bonnet, onion, thyme, bay leaf, curry powder, chicken leg quarter, ripe plantain, vegetable oil

dishes.name: Egusi & Pounded Yam
dishes.short_description: Melon-seed soup, bitter leaf, smoked fish, hand-pounded yam.
dishes.description: Ground melon seeds folded into palm-oil broth with washed bitter leaf, stockfish, smoked catfish and assorted cuts. Rich, nutty and deeply savoury, with silky pounded yam on the side.
dishes.ingredients: Egusi (melon seed), red palm oil, bitter leaf, stockfish, smoked catfish, beef, shaki, ponmo, crayfish, iru, yam

dishes.name: Ofada Rice with Ayamase
dishes.short_description: Local ofada rice, green "designer stew", egg, dodo.
dishes.description: Fragrant, unpolished ofada rice served in leaf, with ayamase: a fiery stew of green peppers bleached in palm oil, with iru, assorted meats and a boiled egg.
dishes.ingredients: Ofada rice, green bell pepper, green scotch bonnet, bleached palm oil, iru, assorted beef, egg, plantain

dishes.name: Pepper Soup
dishes.short_description: Uziza and utazi broth with goat or point-and-kill catfish.
dishes.description: A clear, aromatic broth built on calabash nutmeg, uziza and utazi leaves. Choose tender goat or a whole fresh catfish. Restorative, peppery and best eaten slowly.
dishes.ingredients: Goat meat or catfish, pepper soup spice blend (ehuru, uda, uziza seed), utazi, scent leaf, scotch bonnet

dishes.name: Beef Suya Platter
dishes.short_description: Flame-grilled sirloin in yaji spice, onion, tomato, cabbage.
dishes.description: Thin-cut beef sirloin rubbed in our house yaji (ground groundnut, ginger and chilli), grilled over open flame and served the Northern way, with raw onion, tomato, cabbage and extra yaji to dip.
dishes.ingredients: Beef sirloin, yaji spice (peanut, ginger, cayenne, bouillon), onion, tomato, cabbage

dishes.name: Asun
dishes.short_description: Smoked, peppered goat tossed with onion and scotch bonnet.
dishes.description: Bite-sized goat, smoked then wok-tossed with scotch bonnet, onion and a splash of stock until sticky and fiery. A lounge favourite with a cold Chapman.
dishes.ingredients: Goat meat, scotch bonnet, red onion, bell pepper, vegetable oil, spices

dishes.name: Nkwobi
dishes.short_description: Cow foot in spiced palm-oil cream, utazi, onion.
dishes.description: An Eastern classic: tender cow foot folded into an emulsion of palm oil and potash, warmed with ehuru and crowned with utazi leaves and onion rings. Served in a traditional wooden bowl.
dishes.ingredients: Cow foot, red palm oil, food-grade potash, ehuru (calabash nutmeg), utazi, onion, crayfish, scotch bonnet

dishes.name: Banga Soup & Starch
dishes.short_description: Palm-fruit soup from the Niger Delta, fresh fish, starch.
dishes.description: Delta-style palm-fruit concentrate simmered with beletete, oburunbebe stick and fresh fish until thick and fragrant, served with smooth cassava starch.
dishes.ingredients: Palm fruit concentrate, fresh fish, dried fish, periwinkle, beletete leaves, banga spice, cassava starch

dishes.name: Efo Riro
dishes.short_description: Yoruba spinach stew with assorted meats, iru, crayfish.
dishes.description: Tender greens wilted into a pepper-and-palm-oil base with iru, crayfish, smoked fish and assorted meats. Served with your choice of swallow or white rice.
dishes.ingredients: Spinach (efo shoko), tatashe, scotch bonnet, palm oil, iru, crayfish, smoked fish, beef, shaki

dishes.name: Moi Moi
dishes.short_description: Steamed bean pudding with egg and smoked fish, leaf-wrapped.
dishes.description: Peeled black-eyed beans blended with tatashe and onion, steamed in uma leaves with egg and flakes of smoked fish. Soft, savoury and a must beside jollof.
dishes.ingredients: Black-eyed beans, tatashe, onion, egg, smoked mackerel, vegetable oil

dishes.name: Gizdodo
dishes.short_description: Gizzard and plantain in sweet-spicy pepper sauce.
dishes.description: Crisp-edged chicken gizzards and ripe plantain cubes tossed in a glossy tomato-pepper sauce. Sweet, smoky and dangerously moreish.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken gizzards, ripe plantain, tatashe, scotch bonnet, onion, vegetable oil

dishes.name: Grilled Croaker Fish
dishes.short_description: Whole croaker, pepper marinade, chips or plantain.
dishes.description: A whole croaker scored and marinated in ginger, garlic and scotch bonnet, then grilled until the skin blisters. Finished with a pepper sauce and served with chips or dodo.
dishes.ingredients: Croaker fish, ginger, garlic, scotch bonnet, onion, lime, potatoes or plantain

dishes.name: Puff-Puff
dishes.short_description: Warm, golden dough balls with nutmeg sugar.
dishes.description: Light, pillowy fried dough scented with nutmeg, rolled in sugar and served warm, with a salted-caramel dip for the table.
dishes.ingredients: Flour, yeast, sugar, nutmeg, salt, vegetable oil, caramel (cream, butter)

dishes.name: Chapman
dishes.short_description: Lagos’ signature fruit cooler with cucumber and citrus.
dishes.description: Our house Chapman: grenadine, citrus soda and a dash of aromatic bitters, poured over ice with orange, lemon and cucumber ribbons.
dishes.ingredients: Grenadine, orange soda, lemon-lime soda, aromatic bitters, orange, lemon, cucumber

dishes.name: Zobo
dishes.short_description: Chilled hibiscus with ginger, pineapple and clove.
dishes.description: Dried hibiscus steeped with fresh ginger, pineapple peel and clove, lightly sweetened and served ice-cold. Tart, floral, gently spiced.
dishes.ingredients: Hibiscus calyces, ginger, pineapple, clove, sugar

dishes.name: Pierogi Ruskie
dishes.short_description: Potato and twaróg dumplings, caramelised onion, sour cream.
dishes.description: Hand-pinched dumplings filled with creamy potato and farmer’s cheese, boiled then pan-crisped in butter, topped with sweet caramelised onion and a spoon of sour cream. Our gentlest introduction to Polish cooking.
dishes.ingredients: Wheat flour, egg, potato, twaróg (farmer’s cheese), onion, butter, sour cream, black pepper

dishes.name: Pierogi z Mięsem
dishes.short_description: Meat-filled dumplings with brown butter and herbs.
dishes.description: Dumplings packed with slow-braised beef and pork, pan-fried until golden and finished with brown butter, crispy onions and fresh dill.
dishes.ingredients: Wheat flour, egg, beef shin, pork shoulder, onion, marjoram, butter, dill

dishes.name: Żurek
dishes.short_description: Sour rye soup with white kiełbasa and egg, in a bread bowl.
dishes.description: A tangy, smoky soup made from our own fermented rye starter, with white sausage, bacon, potato and a halved boiled egg, served in a crusty round loaf.
dishes.ingredients: Fermented rye starter (zakwas), white pork kiełbasa, smoked bacon, potato, egg, garlic, marjoram, sourdough bread bowl

dishes.name: Barszcz Czerwony with Uszka
dishes.short_description: Clear beetroot consommé with wild-mushroom dumplings.
dishes.description: A ruby-red, crystal-clear beetroot broth, sweet-sour and earthy, poured at the table over tiny "little ear" dumplings filled with wild mushrooms.
dishes.ingredients: Beetroot, vegetable stock, apple vinegar, garlic, allspice, wheat flour, egg, dried mushrooms, onion

dishes.name: Bigos
dishes.short_description: Hunter’s stew of sauerkraut, smoked meats and mushrooms.
dishes.description: Poland’s great slow-cooked stew: sauerkraut and fresh cabbage braised for hours with smoked sausage, pork, prunes and wild mushrooms. Served with rye bread.
dishes.ingredients: Sauerkraut, white cabbage, kiełbasa, pork shoulder, smoked bacon, dried mushrooms, prunes, tomato, juniper, bay, rye bread

dishes.name: Gołąbki
dishes.short_description: Cabbage rolls of beef and rice in tomato sauce.
dishes.description: Tender cabbage leaves wrapped around seasoned beef and rice, baked slowly in a rich tomato sauce. Comforting, home-style and generous.
dishes.ingredients: White cabbage, minced beef, rice, onion, tomato, allspice, parsley

dishes.name: Kotlet Schabowy
dishes.short_description: Golden breaded pork loin, dill potatoes, mizeria salad.
dishes.description: A pork loin cutlet beaten thin, breaded and pan-fried until shatteringly crisp. Served the classic Sunday way, with buttered dill potatoes and mizeria (cucumber in sour cream).
dishes.ingredients: Pork loin, egg, breadcrumbs, flour, lard, new potatoes, dill, butter, cucumber, sour cream

dishes.name: Placki Ziemniaczane
dishes.short_description: Crispy potato pancakes with sour cream and apple.
dishes.description: Grated potato pancakes fried until lacy and crisp at the edges, with sour cream and a spiced apple compote. Ask for the goulash topping if you’re hungry.
dishes.ingredients: Potato, onion, egg, flour, oil, sour cream, apple, cinnamon

dishes.name: Kiełbasa Platter
dishes.short_description: Grilled smoked sausages, mustard, horseradish, pickles.
dishes.description: A board of grilled smoked kiełbasa with sweet and hot mustards, fresh horseradish cream, ogórki kiszone (fermented cucumbers) and rye bread.
dishes.ingredients: Smoked pork kiełbasa, mustard, horseradish, cream, fermented cucumber, rye bread

dishes.name: Pączki
dishes.short_description: Rose-jam filled doughnuts with orange glaze.
dishes.description: Rich, yeasted Polish doughnuts filled with rose-petal jam, glazed with orange and topped with candied peel. Three to a plate.
dishes.ingredients: Flour, egg yolk, butter, milk, yeast, sugar, rose jam, orange, candied peel

dishes.name: Sernik
dishes.short_description: Baked Polish cheesecake, vanilla, lemon, berry compote.
dishes.description: A tall, dense-yet-light baked cheesecake made with twaróg, vanilla and lemon zest on a buttery shortcrust, with a warm berry compote.
dishes.ingredients: Twaróg, egg, sugar, butter, flour, vanilla, lemon, mixed berries

dishes.name: Szarlotka
dishes.short_description: Polish apple cake with cinnamon and vanilla cream.
dishes.description: Layers of tart, cinnamon-spiced apple between crumbly shortcrust, served warm with vanilla crème anglaise.
dishes.ingredients: Apple, flour, butter, sugar, egg, cinnamon, milk, vanilla

dishes.name: Kompot
dishes.short_description: Homemade fruit cordial of cherry, apple and strawberry.
dishes.description: A Polish grandmother’s drink: summer fruits gently simmered and chilled into a light, lightly sweet cordial.
dishes.ingredients: Cherries, apple, strawberries, sugar, water

dishes.name: Beef Wellington
dishes.short_description: Fillet in mushroom duxelles and puff pastry, red wine jus.
dishes.description: Centre-cut beef fillet seared, wrapped in mushroom duxelles and prosciutto, encased in golden puff pastry and carved at your table. With buttered greens, pommes purée and red wine jus.
dishes.ingredients: Beef fillet, chestnut mushrooms, shallot, thyme, prosciutto (cured pork), puff pastry, egg, potato, butter, red wine

dishes.name: Ribeye with Peppercorn Sauce
dishes.short_description: 300g aged ribeye, green peppercorn sauce, triple-cooked chips.
dishes.description: A 300g dry-aged ribeye grilled to your liking, rested and served with a brandy-and-green-peppercorn cream sauce and triple-cooked chips.
dishes.ingredients: Beef ribeye, green peppercorns, brandy, cream, beef stock, potato, beef dripping

dishes.name: Grilled Salmon with Lemon-Butter
dishes.short_description: Crisp-skinned salmon, lemon-butter sauce, crushed potatoes.
dishes.description: Norwegian salmon fillet grilled skin-side down until crisp, with a beurre blanc of lemon and chives, crushed new potatoes and tender stem broccoli.
dishes.ingredients: Salmon, butter, lemon, shallot, white wine, chives, new potatoes, broccoli

dishes.name: Lobster Thermidor
dishes.short_description: Half lobster in cognac and gruyère cream, herb salad.
dishes.description: Lobster meat folded into a velvety cognac, mustard and gruyère cream, returned to the shell and gratinated. Served with a herb salad and frites.
dishes.ingredients: Lobster, cognac, cream, egg yolk, Dijon mustard, gruyère, parsley, potatoes

dishes.name: Chicken Alfredo
dishes.short_description: Fettuccine, parmesan cream, grilled chicken breast.
dishes.description: Ribbons of fettuccine in a silky parmesan and butter sauce, topped with sliced grilled chicken breast, cracked black pepper and parsley.
dishes.ingredients: Fettuccine (wheat, egg), cream, butter, parmesan, garlic, chicken breast, parsley

dishes.name: Seafood Linguine
dishes.short_description: Prawns, calamari, mussels, chilli, garlic, white wine.
dishes.description: Linguine tossed with tiger prawns, calamari and mussels in a light sauce of garlic, chilli, cherry tomato and white wine, finished with parsley and lemon.
dishes.ingredients: Linguine, tiger prawns, squid, mussels, garlic, chilli, cherry tomato, white wine, olive oil, parsley, lemon

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.short_description: Cos lettuce, anchovy dressing, parmesan, sourdough croutons.
dishes.description: Crisp cos hearts in a classic anchovy-and-garlic dressing with shaved parmesan and sourdough croutons. Add chicken or prawns to make it a main.
dishes.ingredients: Cos lettuce, anchovy, egg yolk, garlic, Dijon mustard, parmesan, sourdough, olive oil, lemon

dishes.name: French Onion Soup
dishes.short_description: Slow-caramelised onions, beef broth, gruyère crouton.
dishes.description: Onions cooked low and slow for hours until deep mahogany, simmered in beef broth with thyme and a splash of brandy, under a bubbling gruyère crouton.
dishes.ingredients: Onion, butter, beef stock, thyme, brandy, baguette, gruyère

dishes.name: Lamb Chops with Rosemary Jus
dishes.short_description: Herb-crusted lamb cutlets, rosemary jus, dauphinoise.
dishes.description: French-trimmed lamb cutlets with a garlic and herb crust, grilled pink, with rosemary jus, potato dauphinoise and glazed carrots.
dishes.ingredients: Lamb cutlets, rosemary, garlic, thyme, breadcrumbs, potato, cream, carrots, lamb stock

dishes.name: Crème Brûlée
dishes.short_description: Vanilla custard under a crackling caramel top.
dishes.description: Madagascan vanilla custard baked gently and torched to order for that first satisfying crack. With shortbread.
dishes.ingredients: Cream, egg yolk, sugar, vanilla, butter, flour

dishes.name: Tiramisu
dishes.short_description: Espresso-soaked savoiardi, mascarpone, cocoa.
dishes.description: Savoiardi soaked in espresso and coffee liqueur, layered with whipped mascarpone and dusted with bitter cocoa.
dishes.ingredients: Mascarpone, egg, sugar, savoiardi biscuits, espresso, coffee liqueur, cocoa

dishes.name: Chocolate Fondant
dishes.short_description: Molten dark chocolate pudding, vanilla ice cream.
dishes.description: A dark chocolate pudding baked to order so the centre stays molten, with vanilla bean ice cream and a tuile. Please allow 15 minutes.
dishes.ingredients: 70% dark chocolate, butter, egg, sugar, flour, cream, vanilla

dishes.name: Dodo
dishes.short_description: Fried ripe plantain.
dishes.description: Sweet ripe plantain, sliced on the bias and fried until caramelised at the edges.
dishes.ingredients: Ripe plantain, vegetable oil, salt

dishes.name: Truffle & Parmesan Fries
dishes.short_description: Skin-on fries, truffle oil, parmesan.
dishes.description: Hand-cut skin-on fries tossed with truffle oil, parmesan and parsley.
dishes.ingredients: Potato, truffle oil, parmesan, parsley, salt

dishes.name: Mizeria
dishes.short_description: Cucumber in dill sour cream.
dishes.description: Thinly sliced cucumber in sour cream with fresh dill and a touch of lemon. Cool and refreshing.
dishes.ingredients: Cucumber, sour cream, dill, lemon, salt

dishes.name: Lagos Sunset (mocktail)
dishes.short_description: Pineapple, passion fruit, lime, grenadine.
dishes.description: Layered pineapple and passion fruit, a squeeze of lime and a grenadine sunset sinking through crushed ice.
dishes.ingredients: Pineapple juice, passion fruit, lime, grenadine

dishes.name: Kraków Garden (mocktail)
dishes.short_description: Apple, elderflower, cucumber, mint.
dishes.description: Pressed apple, elderflower cordial, cucumber and mint, topped with soda. Fresh as a Polish orchard.
dishes.ingredients: Apple juice, elderflower cordial, cucumber, mint, soda water

dishes.name: Fresh Pressed Juice
dishes.short_description: Orange, pineapple, watermelon or tigernut.
dishes.description: Pressed to order. Ask about today’s fruit.
dishes.ingredients: Seasonal fruit

dishes.name: Coffee
dishes.short_description: Espresso, americano, cappuccino or latte.
dishes.description: Single-origin espresso, pulled to order.
dishes.ingredients: Coffee, milk (optional)

dishes.name: Loose-Leaf Tea
dishes.short_description: English breakfast, green, mint or lemongrass & ginger.
dishes.description: Served in a pot for one.
dishes.ingredients: Tea leaves or herbs

dishes.name: House Red Wine
dishes.short_description: Medium-bodied red. 18+ only.
dishes.description: A soft, medium-bodied red with dark-berry fruit. Served to guests aged 18 and over.
dishes.ingredients: Wine

dishes.name: House White Wine
dishes.short_description: Crisp, dry white. 18+ only.
dishes.description: Crisp and dry with citrus and green apple. Served to guests aged 18 and over.
dishes.ingredients: Wine

dishes.name: Bison Grass & Apple
dishes.short_description: Polish bison-grass vodka, cloudy apple. 18+ only.
dishes.description: The classic Polish highball: bison-grass vodka over ice with cloudy apple juice and a cinnamon stick.
dishes.ingredients: Bison-grass vodka, apple juice, cinnamon

dishes.name: Palm Wine Spritz
dishes.short_description: Fresh palm wine, citrus, soda. 18+ only.
dishes.description: Lightly fermented fresh palm wine lifted with orange and soda: a Lagos twist on the spritz.
dishes.ingredients: Palm wine, orange, soda water

dishes.name: Cognac VSOP
dishes.short_description: 50ml, neat or over ice. 18+ only.
dishes.description: Aged cognac, served neat or over a single large ice cube.
dishes.ingredients: Cognac

dishes.short_description: Seven courses travelling from Lagos to Kraków and back.
dishes.description: Our signature experience: seven courses that move between our Nigerian, Polish and Continental kitchens, with each course introduced at the table. Available for dinner, minimum two guests. Price is per guest.
dishes.ingredients: Seasonal: see course list

tasting_courses.name: Pierogi Duo

tasting_courses.name: Fillet & Jollof Risotto

notifications.title: Happy birthday, Chiamaka!
notifications.body: A dessert on us and double points all week.

reviews.title: Proper party jollof
reviews.body: That smoky bottom-pot flavour I thought only my aunty could make. The plantain was perfectly caramelised. We will be back for birthdays.

reviews.title: Tastes like Kraków
reviews.body: I am Polish and living in Lagos for six years. These pierogi made me emotional: soft dough, real twaróg, and the onions are exactly right.

reviews.title: Worth every naira
reviews.body: Carved at the table, pink in the middle, crisp pastry. Service was warm without hovering. Best anniversary dinner we have had in Lagos.

reviews.title: Rich and generous
reviews.body: Egusi was thick and full of meat, pounded yam smooth. Only wish there was a little more pepper, but they offered to adjust it.

reviews.title: Żurek in a bread bowl!
reviews.body: Did not expect to find proper żurek in Victoria Island. Sour, smoky and comforting. The staff explained every dish to my Nigerian colleagues.

reviews.title: Better than Abuja suya
reviews.body: Tender sirloin and the yaji is fresh. Great with a Chapman in the lounge on a Friday night when the band plays.

reviews.title: Three kitchens, one perfect night
reviews.body: We did the Chef’s Tasting Menu for my mother’s 60th. Moving from pepper soup to pierogi to a fillet felt like travelling. The private room was beautiful.

reviews.title: Lovely sernik
reviews.body: Light and creamy like my grandmother’s, with a lovely berry compote. Coffee was excellent too.

reviews.title: Fish was perfect
reviews.body: Whole croaker grilled beautifully with a pepper sauce that had real depth. Portion was big enough to share.

reviews.title: Great steak
reviews.body: Cooked exactly medium-rare as asked, peppercorn sauce had a nice kick. Triple-cooked chips were addictive.

reviews.title: The real party jollof
reviews.body: Smoky, perfectly spiced and the plantain was sweet and caramelised. Delivery arrived hot.
reviews.admin_reply: Thank you so much! We can’t wait to welcome you back to the table.

reviews.title: Better than my babcia’s (don’t tell her)
reviews.body: Soft dough, generous filling and crispy onions. I order these every week now.

reviews.title: Suya done right
